title: Implement a Typed Retry Engine
prompt: Build a cancellable retry engine with typed transport and HTTP failures, timeout budget, exponential backoff and jitter, Retry-After support, and idempotency gating.
successCriteria: Permanent and authentication failures do not loop.
Cancellation stops active call or delay.
Virtual-time tests prove attempts, delays, and exhaustion.
hints: Write down the ownership and failure contract before choosing library APIs.
Prove one adverse or lifecycle case before improving presentation.

starterCode.code: suspend fun <T> execute(policy: RetryPolicy, operation: suspend () -> T): NetworkResult<T>

solutionOutline: Model immutable inputs, outputs, events, and failures at the boundary.
Implement the smallest correct path and verify every success criterion.
verification: Run deterministic state or protocol tests.
Inspect the relevant accessibility, lifecycle, concurrency, or network boundary.
